title: Hybridization of Carbon (sp, sp², sp³)
notes:
Carbon Hybridization (sp, sp², sp³)

Calculated by counting σ (sigma) bonds and lone pairs (π bonds excluded!):
• sp³: 4 σ bonds (alkanes, tetrahedral, 109.5°)
• sp²: 3 σ bonds (alkenes, trigonal planar, 120°)
• sp: 2 σ bonds (alkynes, linear, 180°)
summary: Sigma bond counting rules for organic hybridization.
